ring.$description: Focus ring color for theme-driven focus. Optimized for app-default context/theme. Other contexts/themes may override this value.

focus.$description: System focus color (high accessibility). Optimized for app-default context/theme. Other contexts/themes may override this value.

width.$description: Focus ring width. Fixed 2px geometry for all focus states. Optimized for app-default context/theme.

default.$description: Default focus ring offset. Fixed 2px geometry for all focus states.
